name: portal-assets
description: Build-time only. make assets bundles the editor and the terminal and copies htmx, the terminal's stylesheet and the fonts into internal/web/static.

scripts.build: esbuild editor.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none --outfile=../internal/web/static/editor.js && esbuild term.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none --outfile=../internal/web/static/term.js && sh copy.sh
